# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-10-28):
> stock Strata v0.2.7 (engine 0.1.52) + stock OMP 18.13.2 across all three hosts and the Mac Studio route, rolling back
> to stock Strata v0.2.3 (engine 0.1.48) + stock OMP 18.12.6: on the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a`
> (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock layer split with stock roles
> `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the RTX 4090 as Main staged last, pipeline windows 2, no batch slots, display on
> the RTX 4090, and `strata.ple_io: "direct"` pinning stock `--ple-io direct` to keep the 26.8 GiB per-layer embedding
> (PLE) table on direct SSD reads, preserving the engine's 8,192 MiB automatic conversation cache and 27.3 GiB Windows
> commit headroom of a 135.7 GiB limit;
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/qualification.json)),
> on an RTX PRO 6000 at the trained 262,144-token context with four batch slots, the engine's 8 GiB conversation parking
> and 32K chunks (`win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/qualification.json)),
> and on an RTX 5090 at 131,072 tokens (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/qualification.json)).
> Qualified opt-in (Strata v0.2.7 + OMP 18.13.2, owner decision 2026-10-28): RTX 5090 Coder IQ1_M at 262,144 tokens
> (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/qualification.json)),
> with a 36 GiB available-RAM startup floor and a 1,792 MiB automatic conversation cache (16 parks in G19; G10 serving:
> 9.98 GiB available RAM, 6.92 GiB commit headroom of a 75.2 GiB limit; G16 restart ready in 16.7 s, lowest available
> RAM 8.46 GiB), 21 pass and 3 not applicable (retaining the morning failed receipts beside the passing afternoon
> rerun); operating condition: the host's Docker Desktop and WSL, which also run its production NInfer container, must
> be stopped (39.8 GiB available RAM with them stopped versus 35.7-36.2 GiB with the VM resident, where starts and
> restarts refuse; after WSL restarts that container must be recreated; the v0.2.3 262K rollback has the same
> constraint now because the newer NInfer VM is larger). The 131K profile remains the RTX 5090's current/default; this
> is an explicit opt-in.
> Stock Strata v0.1.40.3 + stock OMP 18.8.4 stays qualified for single-card RTX 3090 hosts
> ([ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.40.3-omp18.8.4/qualification.json)).
> All four server profiles roll back to v0.2.3 (engine 0.1.48) + OMP 18.12.6:
> [PRO, 262K (v0.2.3)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090, 131K (v0.2.3)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090, 262K opt-in rollback (v0.2.3)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6/qualification.json),
> [pair, 262K roles rollback (v0.2.3)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-parking-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6/qualification.json).
> The pair's [v0.2.7 roles manifest with PLE in RAM](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2/manifest.json)
> stays a held draft: G10 measured only 1.03 GiB Windows commit headroom versus 27.3 GiB on PLE-direct and v0.2.3 at the
> same 135.7 GiB limit (0.632-1.331 GiB in a later bench), and engine 0.1.52's PLE policy locked the 26.8 GiB table in
> RAM and left the automatic conversation cache off (reported upstream as
> [Niko1221/Strata#4518](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/4518)). The v0.2.7 campaign is complete across all
> five rows after renaming its pair row to the PLE-direct variant and qualifying the 262K rerun.
> The unmeasured v0.2.7 default-split draft, the default and split-32 v0.2.3 pair drafts and the v0.1.44.1 pair release remain draft, not qualified.
> Each current local ledger has 21 pass and 3 not applicable. Real-host v0.2.7 receipts cite tooling commits `9d3cf88` on the PRO main
> run, `2e50d9a` on the RTX 5090 131K main run with its G15 rerun at `9d3cf88`, `9d3cf88` on the morning RTX 5090 262K
> run with its passing afternoon rerun at `1914e84`, and `7f7b16d` on the pair PLE-direct main run with operator
> receipts at `8c1ae59` (`15c7426` on the held pair roles draft; PRO, 5090 131K and held pair roles operator receipts
> cite `9d3cf88`, `fd645b6` and green [CI run 40663594440](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/actions/runs/40663594440);
> 5090 262K and pair PLE-direct G06 receipts cite green [CI run 40745659264](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/actions/runs/40745659264) at `f3ba668`).
> The RTX 5090 131K main-run G15 failure (thinking-loop stop on the first post-interruption recall and no nonce in its
> client-abort control) and the morning 262K failures with the resident VM stay beside their passing reruns. Engine
> 0.1.52's PLE residency policy locks the 26.8 GiB PLE table in RAM on the PRO (~33.1 s at start; 8,192 MiB automatic
> conversation cache still enabled; 53.7 GB G10 commit headroom) and on the held v0.2.7 128 GB-RAM pair roles draft
> (~31.4-37.5 s at start; conversation cache off), while the current pair PLE-direct profile keeps the table on direct
> SSD reads (`PLE direct read probe: N rows/s (fine)` on every start, no residency-policy line, 8,192 MiB conversation
> cache). Scored (G24): PRO 15/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.3: 17/18), RTX 5090 131K 16/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.3: 17/18), RTX 5090
> 262K opt-in 16/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.3: 14/18; v0.2.1: 15/18), current pair PLE-direct 17/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.3 roles
> rollback: 14/18; held v0.2.7 roles draft: 13/18, pilot 6/6). Per task on the four current v0.2.7 profiles: tool-loop
> 0/3 on PRO, 1/3 on RTX 5090 131K and 262K, and 2/3 on pair PLE-direct; every other task 3/3 (held pair roles draft:
> tool-loop 0/3, multifile-regression 1/3). Protocol counters (including malformed arguments and calls without results)
> are 0 across all four current v0.2.7 server profiles and the held pair roles draft; all task failures stay counted.
> Scored batch walls are 828 s on the PRO (v0.2.3: 578 s), 732 s on the RTX 5090 131K (847 s), 755 s on the RTX 5090
> 262K opt-in (v0.2.3: 831 s; v0.2.1: 778 s) and 1,029 s on the current pair PLE-direct profile (v0.2.3 roles: 1,183 s;
> held v0.2.7 roles draft: 1,194 s); these are not isolated decode latency. v0.2.7 ships its engine (0.1.52) as a
> separately versioned CUDA 13 component tarball staged into `runtime\strata\engine\`, with
> `locks/strata-python-cp313-win_amd64-strata0.2.7.txt` (26 hash-locked wheels adding textual 8.2.8 and its reviewed
> transitive closure); upstream later added its 0.2.7.1 assets (Control 0.1.53, ARM64 and macOS DeepSeek packages) to
> the same GitHub release while the pinned Windows CUDA 13 engine asset remained unchanged; OMP 18.13.2 selects the
> stock `replace` edit tool for Qwen3.8 served IDs (with no edit-mode override) and links continuation session copies,
> and G13 classifies v0.2.7's key-gated `/tool-media/` route.
> On `rtx3090-win-a`, engine 0.1.52's stage order was admitted at `15c7426` after the 2026-10-28 pair roles measurement:
> stock roles (`--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper`, RTX 4090 as Main staged last; layers 0-23 on the RTX 3090 with a 17.6 GiB
> expert cache and 24-47 on the RTX 4090 with 16.01 GiB, auto K=24, pipeline windows 2 decode-capable). Single-sample
> `scripts/perf_probe.py` at the end of the PLE-direct chain (one request per depth, 512 output tokens; not a back-to-back A/B)
> recorded 5.37 / 11.23 / 20.00 / 30.74 s time to first token (TTFT) at 8,192 / 32,768 / 65,536 / 102,400 tokens (prompt reading 1,537 /
> 2,943 / 3,296 / 3,347 tok/s; decode 161-170 tok/s); earlier back-to-back arms on the same PC recorded 5.69 / 11.54 /
> 20.24 / 31.23 s on v0.2.3 roles, 5.60 / 11.36 / 19.92 / 30.40 s on v0.2.7 default residency (PLE in RAM), and 5.63 /
> 11.53 / 20.21 / 31.15 s on a throwaway `STRATA_PLE_AUTO_RAM=0` arm.
> The v0.2.1 profiles on all three hosts (whose host integration roots were removed on 2026-10-28), the PRO and RTX
> 5090 v0.1.44.1 (including 262K opt-in), v0.1.43.1 and v0.1.43 profiles, the pair's v0.1.43.1 and v0.1.43 profiles,
> and each host's v0.1.42 + OMP 18.8.9 profiles stay earlier qualified history. All earlier failed gates and passing
> reruns remain published.
> The pair's [earlier qualified 131K profile](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-disp4090-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> keeps the display on the RTX 4090; its
> [earlier predecessor](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> requires moving the display back to the RTX 3090. Single-card RTX 3090 profiles are not rollbacks
> while both cards are installed: they name GPU 0, now the RTX 4090. Earlier qualified history: on the RTX PRO 6000, stock Strata v0.1.41 + stock OMP
> 18.8.6 with the same choices at 262,144 tokens, then at 131,072 tokens, then the same choices on v0.1.40.3 + OMP
> 18.8.4, then OMP 18.8.3, then v0.1.40.2 + 18.8.0 without them; on the RTX 5090, v0.1.41 + OMP 18.8.6, then
> v0.1.40.3 + OMP 18.8.4, then stock Strata v0.1.34 + stock OMP 18.4.10, which also stays qualified on the
> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`, runs stock
  OMP 18.13.2 through an SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-parking-strata0.2.7-omp18.13.2`,
  the PRO's current v0.2.7 262K profile. Its independent G23 passed on 2026-10-28 at `15c7426`: missing key refused
  before launch, wrong key 401, health RTT 8.0-41.4 ms and stream TTFT 0.316 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight
  with the prior transcript preserved, and nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen (1.04 s), client restart (0.78 s)
  and verified server restart (1.60 s). Its qualified rollback, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-strata0.2.3-omp18.12.6`,
  reaches the PRO's v0.2.3 262K rollback. The 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1, 0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and
  `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.

- [README](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata#readme): status, what the tool does, layout, host-free checks
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the tested install, start, use and stop commands
- [Operations](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): lifecycle, recovery, logs, upgrades, requalifying a new tuple
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): what is and is not isolated, observed egress, known defects
- [Measurements](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/MEASUREMENTS.md): resources, throughput, context, restart cost, evaluation results
- [Decision](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/DECISION.md): integration readiness, usefulness, further investment
- [Baseline](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/BASELINE.md): the frozen component tuple and why it was chosen
- [Upstream](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md): findings reported to Strata and Oh My Pi
- [Release ledgers](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/tree/main/releases): manifest, gate ledger, receipts and scrubbed evidence per profile
